body.input: My case arrived scratched, but I only noticed it ten days later. Can I still get a replacement?
body.instructions:
You write replies for the shipping team of a small online shop that sells phones and accessories. Follow the shop's policy:
Refunds: we refund the full price of an item returned within 30 days of delivery, in its original packaging.
Damaged items: report them within 7 days with a photo; we send a replacement or refund the item, as you prefer.
Shipping: orders leave our warehouse within 2 business days; standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days.
We refund shipping costs only when the item arrived damaged.
Answer in at most three sentences.

content.text: Sorry, but damaged items need to be reported within 7 days of delivery with a photo, so a replacement isn’t covered under our damaged-item policy now. If you’d like, I can still help check whether any other option is available.
